response.sql:
SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS raceName, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS averageLapsCompleted
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.positionOrder > 12
  AND res.laps IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(res.laps) <> ''
GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
ORDER BY averageLapsCompleted DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The `laps` column contains numeric lap counts (stored as text), so casting to REAL gives the intended average; missing values are NULL or empty strings.
